english.note: This is the all-purpose word for animal flesh as food and, with context such as 一種, a particular type of meat.
Use 肉 as the all-purpose choice for bodily soft tissue or animal meat; the context makes the sense clear.

exampleSentences.english: The flesh of this steak is very tender.
